run: plan 4.1: list_sites on the dev cases and on planted splits (src/__tests__/listSitesSplit.test.js); arms A and A+ on the dev set, 2026-10-19
evidence: Plan 4.1 (docs/AGENT_PLAN.md, section D): list_sites returned Mardia's kurtosis only, though the engine computes the per-axis kurtosis, the axis resolution and the PC directions, so the model could not apply the split-site rule analyze_clusters applies; and no tool returned a split site's static displacement, so the model worked out sqrt(rms1² − rms⊥²) by hand, a number provenance flags as unsourced and no reference can carry. Known answer after the change (listSitesSplit.test.js): five planted splits, 1,000 seeds each (equal wells at δ = 3.3σ and 1.5σ, 216 copies, unequal occupation, anisotropic thermal motion; cubic, hexagonal and monoclinic cells): (δ̂ − δ)/SE has a mean of −0.008 to 0.072, an sd of 0.985–1.036 and 95 % coverage of 0.939–0.958, and PC1 lies within 7.6° of the planted [u v w]; a prolate Gaussian is never called split (0 of 1,000); dev-offcentre reads 0.202 ± 0.0028 Å for the planted 0.2 along [0 0 1], dev-zone-boundary 0.0989 ± 0.0029 Å for 0.1, and dev-jahn-teller's split F sites are analyze_clusters' split member sites. Arms A and A+ on the dev set: every record identical before and after (they do not read list_sites). Approved by the manager on the user's delegation, 2026-10-19.
proposed_fix: list_sites rows gain kurtosis_axes (the excess kurtosis on resolved axes only), pc1_uvw (PC1 as a direct-lattice [u v w], crystalOrientationRows, when PC1 is resolved) and, on a split site (isSplitSite, the one rule analyze_clusters' splitMemberSites now calls), delta_A = sqrt(λ1 − (λ2 + λ3)/2) with delta_se_A from the eigenvalues' sampling errors, (κ + 2)·m2²/n each, by the delta method (docs/algorithms/ai-assistant.md, Step 20). rms⊥ is the RMS of the two other axes: it equals arm A's rms2 for the uniaxial splits of the dev cases and avoids its eigenvalue-repulsion bias. Split sites come first in the table, a note check names them, and the description lists the new fields (what the model sees: the list_sites result and description snapshots). Approved by the manager on the user's delegation, 2026-10-19; the user may reverse it.
